Keyword-argument call sites (Tree(url=...)) use flow_kind 'argument' with arg_index 0 as a documented convention: the keyword name is recorded in evidence; CodeQL matching should use the named-argument accessor.

No sanitizer labels: the repository contains no URL scheme allowlist, host allowlist, private-IP/loopback blocking, or redirect policy (grep over cairosvg/); defusedxml forbid_entities/forbid_external (parser.py:390-392) is XXE containment only and is disabled by caller-controlled unsafe=True; the only structural mitigation is a caller-injected restrictive url_fetcher (parser.py:354).

Library trust boundary: CairoSVG is a pure library; source labels on public API parameters (svg2*/convert/CLI) are classification 'candidate' because untrusted-ness depends on the host application, not on the library itself.
file:// and data: schemes are not treated as network SSRF (url.py:140/K-016 cross-CWE note: arbitrary local file read via urlopen; data: pass-through at url.py:33).
urlopen at cairosvg/url.py:84 is the only network egress in the codebase (grep-verified: no requests/httpx/socket/urlretrieve, no fixed-host URLs).
LLM labeling: glm-5.3 via Claude Code CLI agent; 6 batches; deterministic (no sampling temperature); low-confidence entries (<0.65) are flagged for human review in label_stats.md / phase1_review.md.
